research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Multiply Labs is researching automated capsule and cell therapy production. Work on a system, method, and apparatus for capsule fabrication and a system, method, device, and compound for facilitating multicompartment capsules focuses on robotic gripping, capsule bodies, and internal dividers. A system, method, and apparatus facilitating assembly of a capsule targets automated handling of solid dosage forms. Systems for manufacture of engineered cells address robotic, cartridge based cell therapy manufacturing. These activities span robotic capsule fabrication, capsule assembly, and engineered cell production.

overview_description.description: Multiply Labs manufactures personalized pharmaceutical capsules that are tailor-made to the unique needs of each patient. Multiply Labs’ product is enabled by the combination of pharmaceutical science with robotics technology. The company has built and operates a unique robotic pharmaceutical manufacturing facility. Multiply Labs is the first company ever to bring to the market 3D printed capsules.
